{"language":"python","caption":[],"parent":[{"annotations":{"bold":false,"italic":false,"strikethrough":false,"underline":false,"code":false,"color":"default"},"plain_text":"import sqlite3

def init_db():
    dbname = 'sqlite3.db'
    conn = sqlite3.connect(dbname)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todo(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, task STRING, isAchieved BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)')
    conn.commit()
    cur.close()
    conn.close()","href":null}]}

{"language":"python","caption":[],"parent":[{"annotations":{"bold":false,"italic":false,"strikethrough":false,"underline":false,"code":false,"color":"default"},"plain_text":"def check_todo(e, isAchieved, id):
    if isAchieved:
        isAchieved = 0
    else:
        isAchieved = 1
    conn = sqlite3.connect(dbname)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute('UPDATE todo SET isAchieved = ? WHERE id = ?',(isAchieved, id))

    cur.close()
    conn.close()
    fetch_todo()","href":null}]}
